analyst.summary: GE Vernova T&D India is a debt-free, high-return capital-goods business (ROE ~23%, ROCE ~68%) riding India's grid/transmission capex upcycle, with a strong order book (~Rs 21,456cr, about 3.5x trailing revenue) and FY26 profit that more than doubled. The stock's ~95x trailing earnings multiple already prices in a large share of a future national HVDC opportunity that has not yet been converted into firm orders, and management itself signals FY26's unusually high 27% operating margin is not the sustainable run-rate - so near-term earnings growth could decelerate sharply from FY26's pace even as the underlying business keeps growing. Rated Hold.
